goal: Design a mechanism that strengthens 'useful' entries in a knowledge store based on how they get used over time.
narrative: An agent is asked to design a reward/reinforcement mechanism for a knowledge store. The gold corpus holds a prior AgentOps architectural decision about what may legitimately strengthen a knowledge entry. This is a CONTRARIAN-DEFAULT applied-OOD scenario: the model's training default (reinforce on retrieval frequency / citation / co-presence, like recency-weighted RAG and most memory systems) is WRONG for this repo. Compare the design WITH the prior decision retrieved vs WITHOUT.
expected_outcome: The with-knowledge design gates every reward deposit on a VERIFIED OUTCOME (a pass-verdict): co-presence/popularity alone never strengthens an entry, avoiding the reinforcement-amplifies-error death-spiral. The without-knowledge design reinforces on citation/retrieval/co-presence and is a popularity amplifier.

acceptance_vectors.check: design requires a verification/gate verdict before any reward deposit; popularity/co-presence alone never strengthens
design explicitly avoids reinforcement-amplifies-error (a popularity amplifier compounding wrong entries)
EVALUATOR-ONLY: the verification-gating is attributable to retrieving the prior decision, not generic good sense — the control reinforces on popularity
